Seedancer v7.0.0 is a major update introducing advanced director systems for AIGC video workflows.

- Added five new director modules: scene prototype routing, camera-emotion sync, performance micro-beat catalog, JSON API output mode, and lighting rule system.
- Integrated a decision tree for 9 scene prototypes, auto-selecting shot approaches.
- Enhanced emotional mapping: camera behavior now dynamically adapts to character emotion shifts.
- Each emotion decomposed into physical micro-actions for precise actor guidance.
- New JSON API option enables bilingual, structured automated outputs.
- Strict scene lighting control: practical-only sources and scene-dependent color rules.
- Documentation expanded with new references for each feature; redundant documentation removed.

Seedancer v6.0.0 introduces major workflow enhancements and hard-gate logic inspired by Elio_AIGC Seedance 2.0 Prompts V2.3.

- Added five major hard-gate systems: dialogue capacity pre-check, grouping hard gate, shot density four-gate, camera design system, and output/space/pronoun/media-format hard gates.
- Integrated new reference modules: camera-design.md, dialogue-capacity.md, grouping-density.md, output-format.md.
- Updated all main docs to reflect hard-gate logic, stricter format/output standards, and enhanced multi-model support.
- Expanded workflow routing: now includes 10 pre-production/production gates (up from 8).
- Removed skill-card.md; cleaned and consolidated references.
- Credits updated to include Elio_AIGC’s Seedance 2.0 Prompts V2.3 as a major source.

Seedancer v5.0.0 — Major Upgrade: Adds a full pre-production pipeline (P0-P2) for script analysis, creative baseline, character/prop asset management—enabling true end-to-end AIGC film production.

- Introduces P0–P2 pre-production: automated script breakdown, emotion curve visualization, creative/cinematic bibles, character dependency graphs, and prop asset boards (with new reference docs).
- All project flows now start with script fact extraction and explicit user confirmation at each step—ensuring asset/decision traceability.
- Expands and documents core references: story-analysis.md, emotion-curve.md, creative-baseline.md, character-assets.md, prop-assets.md.
- Streamlines confirmation, revision, and asset approval gating; assets/props are not considered "final" until user confirmation.
- Retains and integrates full Seedancer 2.5/Kling/Veo toolset, production flow, and multi-model support; removes redundant documentation (skill-card.md).
- Adds README and versioning files for improved onboarding and clarity.

Seedancer 2.0.1 — 小版本修订

- 阶段二「导演交互」升级为不可跳过的强制步骤，明确为流程红线
- 新增红线条款、详细执行规则和常见违规场景说明，强化多轮确认的执行要求
- 增加版本号与变更日志管理约定
- 维护性文件调整：移除 README.md 和 skill-card.md，新增 _meta.json
- 其他小幅修订与文档结构优化

Seedancer 2.0.0 — 全面升级版，标准化五维度分镜提示词工程

- 全新五维度分镜标准：镜头语言、物理动作、情感节拍、动态光影、时长节奏全覆盖
- 多轮导演交互：剧本解构、视觉风格确认、时空规划分步进行，提升互动体验
- 提示词输出高度结构化，模块化模板适配多种视频生成场景
- 加强 IP/版权风险规避，支持审核安全分级与原创内容策略
- 三大核心模式（纯文本/首帧/全参考）与多档高级场景策略支持
- 平台适配 Seedance 2.0（即梦）全新输入、输出、物理仿真规格
